Top Indian Restaurant
Jun 2025 • Family
The restaurant is located conveniently in the Old Quarter in Hanoi. The ambience and decor is a bit old school however, the food is top notch. Mr Arun, the Manager is simply amazing.

He takes care of everything appropriately and personally looks into your requirements. We went here twice. During our second visit we requested for less oil in the food which was immediately looked after. We had ample food here both Indian Punjabi and Indian Chinese. We walked out fully satisfied. The food is absolutely fresh and very tasty. If you are in Hanoi and looking for the real Indian Meal - this place is absolutely perfect.

Highly recommended.

Average Indian Restaurant in Old Quarter
Aug 2023 • Friends
My recent visit to Zaika in Hanoi's bustling Old Quarter left me with mixed feelings. The restaurant's prime location in the heart of the city is definitely a plus, offering a convenient spot to enjoy a meal while exploring the historic area.

However, when it comes to the food itself, I couldn't help but feel a bit disappointed. While the menu promised a taste of authentic Indian cuisine, the flavors fell short of expectations. I found the dishes to be average at best, and I couldn't help but compare the offerings to other Indian restaurants in the vicinity that seem to do a better job in capturing the essence of the cuisine.

One particular letdown was the papad masala, which not only appeared old but emitted a rather unpleasant odor. It's unfortunate that this experience overshadowed what could have been an enjoyable meal. While the ambiance and location are definite draws, I would suggest that those seeking a truly memorable Indian dining experience might want to explore other options in the area that deliver on both taste and quality.
